verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents OAuth 2.0 authentication with per-endpoint scopes, plus a dedicated tutorial on choosing the right scopes for an app. That supports least-privilege credentials an agent could use, and its API covers invoices, payments, journal entries and reports. Missing for 10: agent- or service-account-specific credential issuance (credentials come through the OAuth app/user flow), documented token lifetime and revocation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the scopes are granular enough in practice.
